step1.text:
OpenWeb Ninja (JSearch job search): Job listings for a role and a place, gathered from LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter and employers' own boards, with posting dates and where to apply. Not for one employer's openings, which its own job board lists.
Price: $0.003 per call, paid by this machine's wallet straight to the provider.
Request: GET https://x402.openwebninja.com/jsearch/search-v2
Inputs:
- query (string, required); The role, the word jobs and the place, e.g. "developer jobs in chicago"
- country (string); Two-letter country code of the job market; outside the US, set both country and language and include the location in query; default "us"
- language (string); Language of the job search, e.g. de for Germany; outside the US, set it together with country and include the location in query
- date_posted (string); one of "all", "today", "3days", "week", "month"; default "all"
- work_from_home (boolean); default false
- employment_types (string); one of "FULLTIME", "CONTRACTOR", "PARTTIME", "INTERN"
- job_requirements (string); one of "under_3_years_experience", "more_than_3_years_experience", "no_experience", "no_degree"
- radius (number)
- num_pages (integer); default 1
- cursor (string)
- exclude_job_publishers (string)
- fields (string)
Example input: {"query":"developer jobs in chicago"}
Returns: JSON {status, parameters, data:{jobs[]}}: postings with title, employer, publisher, location, remote flag, posted date, salary when shown, description and apply links
To run it, call request({id: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", input: {...}}) with the inputs above. Nothing has been paid.
